title: The Salty Seaplane Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Salty Seaplane is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to The Salty Seaplane, a charming 3-bedroom, 4-bath retreat perfectly situated in WaterColor’s sought-after Camp District. Just a 3-minute walk from Camp WaterColor and a short electric cart ride to Seaside and the Beach Club, this stylish home combines comfort, convenience, and coastal charm for an unforgettable 30A getaway.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart 4 Adult Bikes Included Parking for 2 Vehicles Propane Grill Exterior Shower Large Screened Porches 3-Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor 6-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Step into The Salty Seaplane and discover a welcoming blend of modern coastal design and family-friendly comfort. The soft palette of blues and whites, paired with natural wood accents, creates a serene atmosphere throughout the home. The open floor plan connects the spacious living area, dining room, and galley kitchen, making it easy for family and friends to spend time together. The dining area seats eight guests comfortably around a wooden table, with additional bar seating for casual meals. The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless-steel appliances, ample counter space, and everything needed to prepare and share memorable meals. The first floor features a creative and comfortable kids’ suite designed for fun and functionality, offering one twin-over-twin bunk and one double bunk configuration (two twin-over-twin beds) that sleep up to six children. This room includes a private bathroom with a tub and shower combo, plus an additional full bathroom with a walk-in shower nearby for added convenience. Upstairs, two luxurious king suites provide tranquil retreats. The primary suite includes a spacious en suite bathroom with a soaking tub and walk-in shower, as well as private balcony access overlooking a peaceful pond. The second king suite also features its own private bath with a walk-in shower, ensuring all guests enjoy comfort and privacy. Outdoor living is abundant at The Salty Seaplane. The expansive screened porches and shaded seating areas are perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or evening cocktails. Guests can enjoy the propane grill, peaceful pond views, and the quiet charm of the Camp District. With a 6-passenger electric cart and four adult bikes included, exploring Watercolor’s scenic paths, Camp WaterColor, and the Beach Club is effortless and enjoyable.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: One Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed and One Double Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Full Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Laundry Room Life in WaterColor Located in the Camp District, The Salty Seaplane offers unmatched proximity to the community’s favorite gathering spots. Guests are just steps from Camp WaterColor’s pools, playground, and dining, and minutes from the Beach Club and Seaside. Whether cruising along 30A in the electric cart, exploring on bikes, or relaxing on the porch, this home provides the perfect foundation for a memorable WaterColor stay.
